tracks.title: 行頭排
tracks.subject: a 42-year-old office worker who last played trombone in his school band in 1999, roped in by his niece, drum major of a Tuen Mun youth marching band, when the band's only trombonist flies to Osaka for Lunar New Year; marching in the front row of the Lunar New Year night parade in Tsim Sha Tsui he misses her whistle to halt, plays on alone into a squad of American cheerleaders, and ducks to the roadside until his band's bass drum catches up
